name: OSCAR surface currents (1/3 deg, 5-day, 2011-12-06..2014-09-26)
source: https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/griddap/jplOscar (NASA/JPL PO.DAAC OSCAR via NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP; Bonjean and Lagerloef 2002)
licence: Free to use and redistribute, no warranty (ERDDAP dataset licence)
processing: Every 3rd grid point (1 deg), averaged by calendar month ignoring NaN, shifted to 1 deg cell centres by a NaN-aware 4-point mean, lon wrapped to -180..180, packed as int16 at 0.001 m/s in 12 DRFT tiles (`public/data/currents/clim-01..12.bin`)

name: QuikSCAT SeaWinds monthly 10 m winds (RSS science quality, 1999-08..2009-10)
licence: Free to use and redistribute, no warranty (ERDDAP dataset licence)
processing: Every 16th point (2 deg, 75S..75N), averaged by calendar month, monthly-mean speeds over 20 m/s masked (sea-ice contamination), then every remaining no-data cell (coast, sea ice, land; 36% of cells) filled per month by iterative nearest-valid-neighbour extrapolation (repeated NaN-aware 3x3 mean, lon wrapping) so the tile has no gaps, packed as int16 at 0.01 m/s in one 12-frame DRFT tile (`public/data/wind/clim.bin`). Replaces the planned ICOADS climatology, which the ERDDAP server stopped serving

name: NOAA Global Drifter Program 6-hourly QC drifters, 2012-01-01..2014-09-26
processing: One fix per drifter-day (`orderByClosest("ID,time/1day")`), consecutive-day pairs with displacement under 300 km, windage = fix on/after drogue loss, joined to the sampled monthly current and wind fields (878,086 pairs from 4,079 drifters, 2012-01-01..2014-09-25; 9,747 pairs without a current or wind sample dropped: OSCAR coast gaps and poleward of the 75 deg wind grid); training pairs only (not shipped)

name: Natural Earth 1:50m land
processing: Polygons rasterised to a 2048x1024 equirectangular PNG, 255 = land (`public/data/landmask.png`)

name: SalishSeaCast near-surface currents + land mask (Salish Sea tide loop, `public/data/salish/`)
licence: Apache License 2.0, (c) SalishSeaCast Project Contributors and The University of British Columbia
processing: `scripts/data/fetch_salish.py`: VelEast5/VelNorth5 (upper-5 m mean, hourly), 25 consecutive frames from 2026-10-09T08:30Z; model cells with no source current (about 10 % of water cells, coastal/shallow) dropped; nearest remaining model water cell within 1.5 model cells regridded onto a 251 x 284 grid (lon -125.20..-122.70 step 0.01, lat 48.20..49.90 step 0.006), int16 x 0.001 m/s (DRFT tile, cells outside the model domain are no-data); land.png at 4x (1004x1136) from tmask, values 0 = water, 255 = land, 128 = outside the model domain (no model point within 1.5 model cells, or nearest to the model's masked outer boundary row/column; only regions that reach the chart edge); the model's artificial straight Fraser channel (gridX 394) is drawn as land
